title: ChatGPT live browser path via BrowserGlass + MCP Apps
facts: Reviewed prior IMA live-browser discussions: user requires an interactive browser surface inside ChatGPT, not merely an external IMA page.
TinyFish and Opera were explicitly excluded as substitutes.
OpenAI documentation confirms MCP Apps can render interactive UI inside ChatGPT, including inline, fullscreen and picture-in-picture display modes.
OpenAI documentation currently states custom MCP connections are web-only; mobile custom MCP connections are not supported.
IMA already contained an MCP App resource ui://ima/live-browser/v1.html and a BrowserGlass service.
BrowserGlass is an open-source Apache-2.0 project that streams a real Chrome browser into a web page and supports shared human/agent control.
implementation: IMA MCP widget now embeds the IMA BrowserGlass viewer as its live browser surface.
MCP widget CSP now explicitly allowlists https://ima-browserglass.onrender.com as a frame/connect domain.
BrowserGlass viewer now accepts ChatGPT as an authorized embed origin, starts the browser at https://imaosglobal.github.io/, and exposes authenticated HTTPS navigation.
Existing Termux/Chrome attach-only path remains intact and is not used by the BrowserGlass fallback, so the user's existing Chrome is not restarted or controlled by this new path.
verification: Render auto-deploys for ima-universal-action-core and ima-browserglass were observed in update_in_progress after the commit.
GitHub CI status records for the new commit were empty at verification time; CI was not claimed green.
End-to-end ChatGPT-host rendering is not yet verified in this mobile chat because the current ChatGPT mobile surface does not accept custom MCP connections.
next_gate: Connect the IMA custom MCP on ChatGPT web where supported, invoke ima_live_browser, and verify the live BrowserGlass surface, navigation to IMA, human control, and model/tool coordination.
